summary: normalize converts a string to a chosen Unicode normalization form.
documentation: normalize converts a string to a chosen Unicode normalization form. NFC composes canonically equivalent sequences when possible, allowing a precomposed accent and its decomposed letter-plus-mark representation to share the same representation.
inputs: An array of well-formed Unicode strings.
returns: An array normalized to NFC in the same order.
caution: Normalization is not lowercasing, accent removal or a complete name-matching policy. NFC preserves compatibility distinctions that NFKC may fold, including presentation ligatures.
scenarios: Normalize imported text before comparing canonical spellings.
Avoid duplicate local tags caused only by decomposed accents.
Prepare consistent string representations before storing agreed text keys.
title: Normalize canonical spellings
problem: Return each input string normalized to NFC. Preserve order, case and accents; do not apply compatibility normalization or trim whitespace.
hint: Call normalize with the explicit form NFC.
goal: Use String.normalize() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
